components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Tactile yellow CTA button with hard 4px offset shadow and active depression.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FFE000; color: #000000; font-family: 'Fredoka', cursive, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 24px; border: 2px solid #000000; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #000000; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px #000000; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #000000; }

components.name: Surface Button
components.description: White surface button with black border for secondary actions and downloads.
components.css: .ds-btn-surface { background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; font-family: 'Fredoka', cursive, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 18px; border: 2px solid #000000; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0px #000000; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.1s; } .ds-btn-surface:hover { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px #000000; } .ds-btn-surface:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #000000; }

narrative.overview: Droplet rejects the generic, polished corporate cloud aesthetic in favor of a playful, physical, and unpretentious neo-brutalist identity. The design treats every element like a physical cardboard badge or tactile arcade button: thick black outlines, bold drop shadows, and high-energy canary yellow accents.
keyCharacteristics: Inky Boldness: Solid #000000 strokes define all container boundaries; hairline dividers are strictly forbidden.
Tactile Physics: 4px hard offset shadows depress 2px 2px upon user click, providing unmistakable physical feedback.
Expressive Duopoly: Chunky Fredoka display typography paired with utilitarian Inter body text.
Zero Cosmetic Fuzz: No gradients, no frosted glass blurs, and no decorative glow effects.

rules.name: The Inky Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every interactive card and container must have a minimum 2px solid #000000 border. Contrast is non-negotiable.

rules.name: The Rarity of Yellow Rule
rules.body: Canary yellow is reserved for primary CTAs and active state highlights; it covers <=15% of the viewport.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: Blur radius is strictly 0px everywhere. Shadows are opaque physical blocks, never fuzzy gradients.

rules.name: The Click Depression Rule
rules.body: On :active, clickable elements shift translate(2px, 2px) with reduced shadow, creating mechanical haptic satisfaction.

rules.name: The Loud Heading Rule
rules.body: Every heading belongs in Fredoka at weight 700. Never set headings in lightweight body fonts.

dos: Do maintain bold #000000 borders on all interactive cards, pills, and inputs.
Do use Fredoka for all headings, titles, buttons, and badges.
Do preserve the tactile :active depression (translate(2px, 2px)) on all clickable elements.
Do keep error and countdown information visible at all times.
donts: Don't use CSS blur filters, drop-shadow blurs (blur > 0), or soft drop shadows.
Don't use gradient backgrounds, metallic shines, or decorative glowing borders.
Don't introduce low-contrast gray text on gray backgrounds.
Don't hide active countdown timers or room codes behind collapsible menus.
